verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an email inbox platform, so snoozing and follow-up reminders are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no snooze feature and no reminder that resurfaces a thread when nobody replies. Labels for tracking conversation state and webhooks/WebSockets for events are only building blocks a developer could use to build this, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies
